name: BattleEmail
comment: E-mail variant of Battle: game_state 8 runs BattleSetup + BattleWnd::Init, state 3 resumes via BattleWnd::InitResume; result 14 saves state (1048:0ed6)

name: BattleSetup
comment: Fills the 0x192-byte battle info: city/field choice (1028:0002 or computer rule), trade agreement cancelled (NOTRADEDLG), Garde swap + Miliz, ArmyStrength of both sides

name: BattleAftermath
comment: By result code: weapons loot (1068:2d4a, results+0x35/+0x36), KAPUTTDLG, plunder 1028:0eaf/0d46, retreat 1028:011c, initiative cost 1068:3282, Miliz removal and army swap back

name: BattleFameAndXp
comment: Fame table by code 10..13 and strength/title comparison; counters +0x5c1..+0x5c7; +8 XP (1068:4671) for army1 of each side

name: FightRaiders
comment: Event 17 (mode 1 marauders, 1068:4d7c) or 19 (mode 2 Lindwurm, 1068:506a) battle; fame +-5/7, +0x5c9/+0x5cb, +8 XP on win; returns 1 on win

name: BattleWnd::Init
comment: Constructor (VMT DS:2d2c): copies side0 = defender/raiders, side1 = attacker; buttons Warten/Fertig/Aufgeben; winter Random(6)=0; start positions; MAPDATA; city layout

name: BattleWnd::InitResume
comment: Constructor for a resumed e-mail battle: restores maps, current side and results from the extra block

name: BattleWnd::InitMorale
comment: Per side: morale base = happiness + fame/300; Heilende Haende flag; Entertainer flag; fear 0.2 vs enemy Terror, +0.2 for the attacker in winter; human flags

name: BattleWnd::SetupWindow
comment: VMT +0x38: loads STOP/SWORD/GO/HEAL cursors, centres window, starts timer DAT_6794; computer side 0 starts defensive

name: BattleWnd::WMCtlColor
comment: DMT wm 0x0019 (WM_CTLCOLOR): transparent background for statics

name: BattleWnd::SetCursor
comment: SETCURSOR wrapper

name: BattleWnd::EnableButtons
comment: Enables the three buttons

name: BattleWnd::DisableButtons
comment: Disables the three buttons (computer side)

name: BattleWnd::GetResults
comment: City battle: civilians killed = min(pop-50, side0 losses*pop/50); copies results (0x37) and both player records back after ResetSide

name: BattleWnd::SaveEmailState
comment: Result 14: stores maps, current side, winter and results into the e-mail extra block

name: BattleWnd::DrawMap
comment: VMT +0x54: draws the 15x11 grid (32px cells), bitmaps 1000+code, units 1100/1200+type, snow +20; Camouflage units outside the city are hidden

name: BattleWnd::DrawPanelFrames
comment: Draws the two 80x200 status panel frames

name: BattleWnd::ClearTargetPanel
comment: Blanks the lower (target) status panel

name: BattleWnd::DrawUnitStatus
comment: Status panel: rank orders, effective attack/defence, range, steps, ammo, HP bar, blind/KO/stance icons, morale face; calls ComputeMotivation

name: BattleWnd::DrawCell
comment: Draws one cell for a map code (terrain, unit frames 0x6f..0xbc for blinking/animation, 10 = hit overlay)

name: BattleWnd::OtherSide
comment: (current side + 1) mod 2

name: BattleWnd::IsInCity
comment: City battle and unit at x 11..13, y 4..6

name: BattleWnd::IsThreatened
comment: Some enemy is adjacent, or within its range with ammo > 0

name: BattleWnd::HeroShouldFlee
comment: Current unit hp/max_hp < 0.2 and IsThreatened

name: BattleWnd::AnyUnitInMelee
comment: Some unit of the current side has an adjacent melee enemy

name: BattleWnd::CountAdjacentEnemies
comment: Number of melee-capable (DS:2ca0) enemies at distance 1; >3 halves defence

name: BattleWnd::HasAdjacentFriendOfType
comment: Adjacent friendly unit of a type, conscious, stance 0 (used with type 34 Knappen)

name: BattleWnd::InBounds
comment: x in 1..14 and y in 1..10 (excludes column/row 0; used for en-passant neighbours)

name: BattleWnd::StrengthBalance
comment: (own - enemy)/(own + enemy) with sum(attack+defence) per side; Real

name: BattleWnd::ComputeMotivation
comment: unit+0x30 := clamp(base + balance + level/10 + DS:5300 - DS:52dc*fear + pay/base_pay-1 + 0.25 Entertainer, 0.5, 1.1)

name: BattleWnd::RefreshUnitCodes
comment: Rewrites side codes 0x6e+i / 0x78+i into the occupancy grid

name: BattleWnd::CanMoveTo
comment: VMT +0x58: neighbour cell; free, trees (DS:2cc4), rivers (winter/Schwimmer/DS:2cc4), own buildings for the defender

name: BattleWnd::MoveUnit
comment: En-passant strikes by adjacent active melee enemies (Duckmaeuser 50%), then move 1 cell for 1 step; x>7 sets +0xf82

name: BattleWnd::CanAttack
comment: VMT +0x5c: target rules for units, buildings (attacker only), walls (Sprengpulver/Demontage), trees (Demontage)

name: BattleWnd::Duel
comment: VMT +0x60: hit if Random(Round(atk+1)) >= Random(Round(def+1)); damage Random(Round(attack/3*mult))+1; KO/blind/poison; step and ammo costs

name: BattleWnd::AttackUnit
comment: Sets Knappen/surrounded flags, calls Duel; on kill: kills/xp +1, counters, Vampire infection (1068:674b) or removal

name: BattleWnd::AttackObject
comment: VMT +0x64: Random(attack) (Pechpfeile x3, blind /2) >= Random(DS:2b83[obj]) or Demontage/Flammenstoss; results counters

name: BattleWnd::CanHeal
comment: Heilkraefte, ammo > 0, own unit at distance <= 1

name: HealUnit
comment: +Random(min(lvl,3)+1)+1 HP (0 for Vampires), clears blind/KO; healer steps 0, ammo -1

name: BattleWnd::DoHeal
comment: Heal animation + HealUnit

name: BattleWnd::DesertionCheck
comment: DS:52b8 types: RandomReal*0.6 > motivation -> defects (UEBERLAUFDLG, enemy < 8 units) or deserts (DESERTDLG)

name: BattleWnd::RedrawUnit
comment: Redraws a unit cell (terrain only for hidden Camouflage units)

name: BattleWnd::EndAction
comment: VMT +0x68: end checks (10/11), desertion, NextUnit, side switch with StartSideTurn, e-mail break 14

name: BattleWnd::AiStep
comment: One computer action per timer tick: retreat check (12/13), attack, move or stance

name: BattleWnd::AiChooseAggressive
comment: Attacker always; city defender never; field defender by tactic +0xe2e or balance > 0.5

name: BattleWnd::AiEnemyOutguns
comment: Sum of attack of enemy units that reach our units exceeds ours

name: BattleWnd::AiFindEnemyHero
comment: First enemy unit of type 9

name: BattleWnd::AiFirstEnemy
comment: Position of enemy unit 1

name: BattleWnd::AiLastEnemy
comment: Position of the last enemy unit

name: BattleWnd::AiFindHelplessEnemy
comment: First enemy that is blind or unconscious

name: BattleWnd::AiFindFastEnemy
comment: First enemy of type 5/17/19/25/30

name: BattleWnd::AiFindWeakestEnemy
comment: Enemy with the lowest current HP

name: BattleWnd::AiFindMostWoundedFriend
comment: Healer only: own unit with the largest HP loss

name: BattleWnd::AiFindEnemyWithAbility
comment: First enemy with the given ability

name: BattleWnd::AiFindHealingEnemy
comment: First enemy in stance 2 (Heilen)

name: BattleWnd::AiPickWallTarget
comment: Attacker in a city battle: random wall cell from DS:2ec6/2ecc

name: BattleWnd::AiPickAdjacentBuilding
comment: Attacker in a city battle: adjacent building cell

name: BattleWnd::AiChooseTarget
comment: Target preference by unit type, with random fallbacks

name: BattleWnd::AiNearestEnemy
comment: Enemy unit closest to a point

name: BattleWnd::AiStepToward
comment: Neighbour cell (CanMoveTo) that minimises the distance to a target

name: BattleWnd::AiTryAttack
comment: Attack the chosen target, 15% an adjacent building, else the nearest enemy

name: BattleWnd::AiChooseStance
comment: Defender: heal when wounded and unthreatened; dig in when defensive and no adjacent enemy

name: BattleWnd::AiMove
comment: Step toward the target/nearest enemy; the city defender stays inside x 11..13, y 4..6; cautious hero +0xe2f

name: BattleWnd::AiShouldRetreat
comment: Hero flee and balance < -0.2; attacker/city balance < -0.33 and 90%; field defender < -0.5 and 40%; never for Lindwurm

name: BattleWnd::StartSideTurn
comment: Steps refill (winter -1, min 1), regeneration Chance(50*r), blind/KO counters -(r+1), computer stance ends, reset when nobody is active

name: BattleWnd::ResetSide
comment: hp/steps/ammo := max, blind/KO/stance := 0

name: CombatOptions_MoreThanOneActive
comment: Nested helper of 1048:8c92: more than one unit with stance 0

name: BattleWnd::CombatOptionsMenu
comment: KAMPFOPTDLG: 0x65 Eingraben (stance 1), 0x66 Heilen (stance 2), 0x67 Aktivieren, Warten, Fertig

name: BattleWnd::NextUnit
comment: Next unit (cyclic) with steps > 0, stance 0 and conscious; 0 if none

name: BattleWnd::EndBattle
comment: Calls VMT +0x50 (EndDlg) with the result code 10..14

name: BattleWnd::WMLButtonDown
comment: Human click: CanMoveTo -> MoveUnit, CanHeal -> DoHeal, CanAttack -> AttackObject/AttackUnit

name: BattleWnd::WMMouseMove
comment: Cursor GO/SWORD/HEAL/STOP and target status panel

name: BattleWnd::WMRButtonDown
comment: Combat options for own active units; WinHelp topic 400+code for terrain

name: BattleWnd::WMTimer
comment: Start delay of 3 ticks; computer side -> AiStep; human side -> blink the current unit

name: BattleWnd::StartTimer
comment: SETTIMER with DAT_6794

name: BattleWnd::StopTimer
comment: KILLTIMER

name: BattleWnd::CmWarten
comment: Button 101: NextUnit without ending the unit's turn

name: BattleWnd::CmFertig
comment: Button 102: steps := 0, EndAction

name: BattleWnd::CmAufgeben
comment: Button 103: RUECKZUGDLG (KAPDLG for the city defender) -> EndBattle 12 (attacker) / 13 (defender)

name: BattleWnd::Done
comment: VMT +0x08 destructor: cursors, timer

name: Seg10_InitBattleFont
comment: Unit initialisation: LOGFONT DS:606c Comic Sans MS for the status panels

name: LoadMapData
comment: FINDRESOURCE MAPDATA id n+1, copies 165 bytes (15x11, column-major)

name: Distance
comment: Round(sqrt(dx^2+dy^2))

name: AddGoodsCapped
comment: Goods slot n (4 = weapons) += amount, capped by WarehouseFreeSpace, only with goods trade

name: FillWithMilitia
comment: Fills army1 to 8 with Miliz: att 1+pop/3500, def 1+pop/4500, hp 1+pop/3000 (max 6)

name: GenerateMarauders
comment: Marauder record: count Random(n)+3 (n = strength/8), tiers from DS:57a7..

name: GenerateLindwurm
comment: Monster record with one Lindwurm (type 12)

name: RemoveArmy1Unit
comment: Deletes army1 unit i, shifts the rest, count -1

name: RemoveMilitia
comment: Truncates army1 at the first Miliz (type 0)

name: SwapArmies
comment: Swaps army1 and army2 (city garrison fights)

name: AvengerJoinsWeaker_q
comment: Before battle: header unit DS:611d joins the clearly weaker side (via 1068:5b06); thresholds unconfirmed

name: AvengerLeaves
comment: After battle: removes the type-13 unit (Reisiger Raecher) again

name: MakeVampire
comment: Copies a unit as a Vampire: type 10, full HP, range 1, level/xp/pay 0, ability DS:5284

name: ObjectHardness
comment: byte[14] by map code, for AttackObject

name: StartPosAttackerCity
comment: x[8] at 2b94, y[8] at 2b9c (index 1..8)

name: StartPosAttackerField
comment: x[8] at 2ba4, y[8] at 2bac

name: StartPosDefenderCity
comment: x[8] at 2bb4, y[8] at 2bbc

name: StartPosDefenderField
comment: x[8] at 2bc4, y[8] at 2bcc

name: CityMillPositions
comment: x[8] at 2bd4, y[8] at 2bdc

name: CityMarketPositions
comment: x[4] at 2be4, y[4] at 2be8

name: UnitCharmable
comment: byte[36] attack halved by Charme

name: UnitChristian
comment: byte[36]; 0 = heathen (Heilige Lanze x1.5)

name: UnitMeleeCapable
comment: byte[36]; 0 for Artillerie, Alchimisten

name: UnitCrossesTerrain
comment: byte[36]; trees/rivers passable, no winter step loss (Lindwurm)

name: NeighbourDX
comment: s16[8] x offsets of the 8 neighbours (dy at 2e9e)

name: UnitIsKnight
comment: byte[36]; +1 attack next to Knappen

name: UnitCanDesert
comment: byte[36]; DesertionCheck 1048:5dc0

name: UnitFearSusceptible
comment: byte[36]; multiplies the Terror/winter fear in ComputeMotivation

name: UnitMoraleBonus
comment: Real48[36] added to motivation (0.2 standard, 2.0 Held)
